Why are you here, human?\nHuh, of course I know.\nYou came to save this kid, right?
Don't move! Or this kid will die.
Ha ha ha ha ha! There's nothing you can do.\nJust watch this kid melt in my body!
Run. Get out of here right now...
I'll leave the rest to you...
You shall feel my blood boiling with anger!!
You need to look for Marelli...
What a relief! You're safe.\nWhen I was searching around there,
this kid ran to me and said you're fighting\na monster...
Oh, sorry. I got stuck killing little monsters.\nSo, you were here. Where's the monster?
You're late, Balft.\nThis adventurer defeated the monster and\nsaved him.
What? You defeated it alone?!\nA black knight? No, I didn't see him.\nSo, the knight helped you...
...Me? No, I didn't see him either.\nSounds mysterious.
Anyway, he's safe.\nLet's escort him to the butler.
